scripts.//clear:modules: Deletes every module rich text does not embed and takes the inline ones out of the page stack, so a project starts its own modules from an empty modules[]. --dry-run lists the changes.
scripts.//test:tooling: node:test suites for check-wiring and scaffold-module, including end-to-end runs through generate, check:wiring and tsc: two scaffolded modules (one inline), and clear:modules followed by a first module.
scripts.//generate: Studio schema extract, then the web query types (TypeGen) and a check that every web query got a type. Run after every schema or query edit.
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter studio run generate && pnpm --filter web run generate && pnpm run check:typegen
scripts.//dev: Starts web (3000) and studio (3333) in parallel; `web:dev` / `studio:dev` start one.

pnpm.//overrides: magicast pin avoids the older transitive 0.2.x version pulled in by some Sanity tooling, which lacks the `parseExpression` API used downstream. Re-evaluate when removing — drop the override and run `pnpm why magicast` to confirm only ^0.3 versions remain.
